summary:
H.J. Res. 27 is a joint resolution of congressional disapproval under the Congressional Review Act, chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code. Its sole operative provision disapproves the rule submitted by the Department of the Army, Corps of Engineers, Department of Defense, and the Environmental Protection Agency entitled “Revised Definition of ‘Waters of the United States’,” published at 88 Fed. Reg. 3004 (Jan. 18, 2023).

The resolution provides that the rule “shall have no force or effect.” As a CRA disapproval resolution, the operative mechanism is enactment of a joint resolution under 5 U.S.C. §§ 801–808 to nullify the specified agency rule. The text does not amend any provision of the United States Code, create any new regulatory authority, authorize appropriations, make appropriations, establish deadlines, or prescribe implementation procedures beyond the statutory consequence of congressional disapproval. It contains no exceptions, savings clauses, delayed effective date, or conditions other than enactment of the joint resolution.
